Ledger helps you keep track of your business money by taking the CSV file your bank lets you export and adding each transaction to a simple ledger file on your own computer, so there's no account to create, nothing to upload, and no subscription to pay. You can safely import the same export twice because Ledger skips any transaction it has already imported. It works out of the box with exports from Sberbank, Tinkoff and Revolut, with other banks needing just a column mapping, and it's free and open source under the MIT licence.
